title: First-run telemetry storyboard: compact latency-cost ribbon & trace microcards
creator: Julian Park
description: Deliver a compact set of onboarding visuals for first-run telemetry that showcase latency percentiles, cost-per-token ribbon, and a tight trace microcard layout for the Console quickstart. Assets must work as both full-width hero images and tiled thumbnails for the guided tour. Include desktop and narrow (tablet) crops, and export annotated PNGs for docs and compressed SVGs for the product tour.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screenshots: (1) Latency ribbon (p50/p95/p99) with popover annotations, (2) Cost-per-token heatstrip aligned with time series, (3) Trace microcards grid showing sample spans + KV cache hit rate.
All assets exported to Drive in 2 resolutions and linked in ticket.
Figma file has developer spec notes (margins, font tokens, accessible color contrast) and export presets.
Screenshots used in docs have localized alt text drafts for engineering docs team.
screenshots: Latency ribbon (p50/p95/p99) with percentile hover state captured at 95th percentile spike
Cost-per-token heatstrip aligned under request volume showing burst cost blips
Trace microcards: 6 compact cards each with trace duration, span count, KV cache hit%, sample stack snapshot
Rollout panel inset showing canary vs primary latency comparison (mini sparkline)
Compact mobile crop showing single microcard + cost ribbon stacked
updates: 2026-03-03 — Ticket created by Julian: initial brief and asset list. Asked to prioritize mobile-friendly crops.
2026-03-05 — Design exploratory sketches uploaded to Figma. Chose ribbon pattern for cost visualization after feedback from PM (Diego Martinez).
2026-03-07 — Internal review with PM & Eng: requested explicit KV cache metric in microcards and a subtle red highlight for p99 SLA breaches.
2026-03-09 — Exported first-pass PNGs to Drive; linked PRs created for Console and Docs. Dev requested SVG badge for KV cache instead of PNG.

2026-03-12 — Design pass 2: improved typography scale for small microcards and adjusted color tokens to meet AA contrast; prepared final export manifest. Marking In Progress -> awaiting final dev sign-off on PR #2241.
developer_notes: Include metadata overlay for each screenshot: model name, sequence length, region, and release tag for reproducibility.
Trace microcards should surface KV cache hit rate as percentage and provide a CTA link to raw trace in Traceboard.
When embedding in docs, use the 1024px width variant for docs hero and 360px thumbnail for in-page cards.
